        b = n['boundary']
        rmin = min(r for r,c in b)

        print(f"  id={n['id']:2d} color={n['color']:2s} px={n['pixels']:4d} rect=[{rmin},{cmin}]")
print("Level completed:", result.get('level_completed'))
